target_customer: Proptech software builders, property owners and managers needing integrations with property management systems
problem: Each property management system has its own integration, so engineers spend months building point connections.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage-based unified API
product_category: unified API and data platform for property management systems

founders.name: Remen Okoruwa
founders.background_notes: Named CEO and co-founder in the Commercial Observer seed article of 2023-10-10; the YC page names him only as Remen.

founders.name: Nick Johnson
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a hacker and builder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Normalizing data across many closed property management systems is mostly integration grind with undocumented APIs rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Hard won connectors and customer data pipelines are tedious to replicate, but PMS vendors can open their own APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The platforms were integration targets, not rivals, in launch coverage; no copy or acquisition is reported.

market_need_then: Seed coverage states that integrations took engineers months and that founders pitched a universal translator between systems; no quantified spend figure was found.

branding.domain_note: Now propexo.com; earlier Propify at propify.com.

identity.logo: black and white versions per site
identity.voice_and_tone: plain and direct, short punchy outcome focused sentences

branding.brand_signature: Plaid for Commercial Real Estate tagline

rebrands.why: Pivot from rent payments in fall 2022; PROPEXO trademark filed 2023-08-17 by RentDrop, Inc. The rename date is not sourced.

brand_strength.rationale: Name was changed once already, a profile noted the wordmark is hard to read, and no press covers the brand itself.

pivots.to: Propify unified API for real estate
pivots.why: Commercial Observer reports the pivot in fall 2022; reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Propexo pivoted out of the rent payment app RentDrop in fall 2022, was in YC Winter 2023 and closed a 3.3M seed in October 2023 led by Prudence. It remains active and now sells a data platform for multifamily plus the unified API, with 127 plus integrations claimed on its site. A later 5M Series A and a 9M total appear only on CB Insights, so growth after seed is unverified.
notes: CB Insights reports a Series A of 5.03M on 2025-09-17 and 9.18M total over 6 rounds; one other aggregator says 10M total. Seen only on aggregators so unverified and not recorded as a round. Founding year conflicts: YC says 2022, CB Insights 2020. Competition: no dated near-2023 competitor sources found; a directory later named Apideck and others without dates.
